query:
-- Fix Wyoming: Lummis declined to seek re-election — open seat, R primary Aug 18
UPDATE senate_races SET
  incumbent = 'Open Seat (Cynthia Lummis retiring)',
  notes = 'Open seat — Cynthia Lummis (R) declined to seek re-election. R primary Aug 18, 2026. D primary Aug 18, 2026. Cook/IE/Sabato: Solid Republican.'
WHERE state_code = 'WY';

-- Fix Georgia: Runoff is Collins vs Dooley (June 16) — add Dooley to candidate2 field
UPDATE senate_races SET
  candidate2_name = 'Collins or Dooley (R runoff June 16)',
  notes = 'Jon Ossoff (D) uncontested in D primary. R primary May 20: Collins 40.5%, Dooley 30.2%, Carter 25.1%. Collins and Dooley advance to R runoff on June 16. Cook/IE/Sabato: Lean Democrat.'
WHERE state_code = 'GA';

-- Fix Oklahoma: Alan Armstrong is the current senator (replaced Lankford who retired)
UPDATE senate_races SET
  incumbent = 'Open Seat (Alan Armstrong / Lankford seat)',
  notes = 'Open seat — James Lankford retired; Alan Armstrong appointed but not running. R primary Jun 16: Kevin Hern (frontrunner), Sean Buckner, Gary England, Nick Hankins, Brian Ragain, Tammy Swearengin, Wayne Washington. D primary Jun 16: R.O. Joe Cassity, Troy Green, Rebekah LaVann, Jim Priest, N''Kiyla Thomas, Ervin Yen. Rating: Solid Republican.'
WHERE state_code = 'OK';
